name: CV / resume field extraction
summary: Extract structured fields from CVs/resumes over cv:// URIs — name, contact details, position, skills, experience, education, languages. Text via python-docx (DOCX) or doc:// OCR (PDF/image), fields via an LLM pass (OpenRouter).
description: cv:// turns résumé parsing into a first-class URI. cv://host/document/query/parse returns structured fields {full_name, address, email, phone, position, skills, experience, education, languages, summary, raw_text} from one PDF/DOCX/image/text file — DOCX is read directly via python-docx, everything else is delegated to doc:// (urirun-connector-ocr, which already layers pdftotext/PaddleOCR/tesseract). Unlike invoice://, a CV has no stable label grammar to regex against, so field extraction is LLM-first (OpenRouter via litellm) rather than regex-first with an LLM fallback; use_llm=false returns only the extracted raw text so OCR quality can be inspected before spending an LLM call. cv://host/folder/query/batch parses every CV under a folder into rows, for a one-off backlog import. Read-only over the CV files.

system: poppler-utils (pdftotext/pdftoppm) and/or tesseract, via doc:// — for PDF/image CVs
optional: litellm + OPENROUTER_API_KEY for field extraction (use_llm=true, the default)

useCases: Extract a candidate's name, contact details, position, skills and experience from a submitted CV.
Feed extracted CV fields into a contract-generation template's variables.
Batch-import a backlog folder of CVs into structured rows.
Inspect OCR text quality on a scanned CV before spending an LLM call (use_llm=false).
